label: On Health
summary: Platina's treatise on right pleasure and good health.

value.text: no. 113, Medicine, Anatomy, Astrology and Miscellany

claims.statement: Entered as no. 113 in the reconstructed catalogue of Leonardo's books, under Medicine, Anatomy, Astrology and Miscellany. Leonardo's wording as rendered there: "on the preservation of health".

claims.statement: Identified in the reconstruction as De honesta voluptate et valetudine. The identification of a title in Leonardo's lists with a specific work and edition is an interpretation.
